declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_runtime_create
declarations.doc:
Create a V8-backed jsi_runtime.

abi_version: the JSI_ABI_VERSION the consumer compiled against. A version
  this implementation does not support fails with
  jsi_status_version_mismatch.
configure: invoked with a factory-owned jsi_config so the consumer can set
  fields via the v8_jsi_abi_config_set_* setters below. May be NULL
  (defaults). The config handle is valid only for the duration of that
  callback. If configure returns a failure status, creation fails with it.
  If a setter failed (poisoning the config), creation fails with that
  setter's status even if configure returned jsi_status_ok.
user_data: passed straight through to configure.
out_runtime: receives the runtime (refcount 1; release via
  runtime->api->release), or NULL on failure.

Returns jsi_status_ok, jsi_status_invalid_arg (out_runtime NULL),
jsi_status_version_mismatch, the configure/poison status, or
jsi_status_native_error if V8 could not create the isolate.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_initial_heap_size
declarations.doc: Initial V8 heap size in bytes. 0 means the V8 default.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_maximum_heap_size
declarations.doc: Maximum V8 heap size in bytes. 0 means the V8 default.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_thread_pool_size
declarations.doc:
Cap the V8 worker thread pool. 0 means default
(V8 picks min(num_cores - 1, 16)).

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_debugger_runtime_name_utf8
declarations.doc:
Name shown in the inspector UI to distinguish parallel runtimes. The text
is copied. length may be JSI_ABI_AUTO_LENGTH; value may be NULL only when
length is 0 or JSI_ABI_AUTO_LENGTH (an empty name).

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_inspector_enabled
declarations.doc: Enable the V8 inspector. Default: false.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_inspector_port
declarations.doc: Inspector TCP port.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_inspector_break_on_start
declarations.doc: Pause on the first statement until a debugger attaches. Default: false.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_explicit_microtask_policy
declarations.doc:
If true, the runtime uses MicrotasksPolicy::kExplicit and the host must
drain microtasks itself. Default is false (V8 default policy).

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_ignore_unhandled_promises
declarations.doc:
If true, the PromiseRejectCallback that tracks unhandled rejections is
NOT installed. Default is false (track rejections).

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_gc_api_enabled
declarations.doc: Expose the global gc() function (passes --expose_gc to V8).

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_multi_thread_enabled
declarations.doc: Wrap isolate access in v8::Locker for multi-threaded use.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_jit_tracing_enabled
declarations.doc: Log JIT code events.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_message_tracing_enabled
declarations.doc: Log inspector protocol messages.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_gc_tracing_enabled
declarations.doc: Log GC events.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_system_instrumentation_enabled
declarations.doc:
V8 ETW provider GUID 57277741-3638-4A4B-BDBA-0AC6E45DA56C
(passes --enable-system-instrumentation to V8).

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_snapshot_destroy
declarations.doc: Free a container returned by v8_jsi_abi_snapshot_create. NULL is a no-op.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_startup_snapshot
declarations.doc:
Supply a V8 startup-snapshot container (built with
v8_jsi_abi_snapshot_create) to a runtime. The isolate is created from it
(Isolate::CreateParams::snapshot_blob) so the embedded script's heap is
pre-materialized — neither parsed nor run.

Lifetime: the config takes ownership of data when the setter is called; on
v8_jsi_abi_runtime_create the runtime takes over. The runtime keeps the
bytes alive for the isolate's lifetime and calls
data_delete_cb(data_delete_data, data) exactly once on destroy. If creation
fails before the runtime is built, the config fires the deleter instead.
data_delete_cb may be NULL (the bytes are then caller-owned and must
outlive the runtime). NULL data with size 0 clears any previously set
snapshot; NULL data with a nonzero size is jsi_status_invalid_arg.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_snapshot_compat
declarations.doc: Snapshot-container compatibility. See the compatibility notes above.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_snapshot_compat
declarations.doc: Snapshot-container compatibility. See the compatibility notes above.

enumerators.name: v8_jsi_abi_snapshot_compat_flags_mismatch
enumerators.doc: engine build flags differ (cage, pointer compression, lite mode)

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_snapshot_check
declarations.doc: Checks whether this engine can load a snapshot container. See above.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_snapshot_compat_to_string
declarations.doc:
Human-readable description of a v8_jsi_abi_snapshot_compat (never NULL;
an unknown value gets a generic string).

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_script_cache_load_cb
declarations.doc: Loads cached bytecode. See the script cache notes above.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_script_cache_store_cb
declarations.doc: Stores cached bytecode. See the script cache notes above.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_script_cache
declarations.doc: Configures callbacks described in the script cache notes above.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_task_run_cb
declarations.doc: Runs a foreground task. See the task runner notes above.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_task_runner_post_task_cb
declarations.doc: Posts a foreground task. See the task runner notes above.

declarations.name: v8_jsi_abi_config_set_task_runner
declarations.doc: Configures the foreground task runner described above.
